answer_1.quote: In machine translation (MT) gender bias has received significant attention...

answer_2.quote: automatic evaluation of gender bias does not accurately reflect the found humancentered effort disparities... we use the set of contrastive F/M target references to compute gender-related performance differences with BLEU.

answer_4.quote: In a controlled setup, 88 participants post-edited MT outputs to ensure either feminine or masculine gender translation.
answer_4.guideline: participants were instructed to carry out a light PE - i.e. targeting only essential fixes to adjust the overall quality of the translation ... with a focus on ensuring either feminine or masculine translation for human referents
